purpose: Quantify whether the unusually early half-pressure crossing in one PRESLHY E5.1 ambient trace is caused by high-frequency pressure noise; do not replace the frozen primary result.

method.trace_selection: The three primary ambient E5.1 cases already selected by the frozen protocol.
method.filter: Centered odd-window median filter applied only to the measured source-pressure trace.

interpretation.observation: A 100 ms median filter removes sub-window pressure oscillations in all three traces; the first case changes from an apparent 0.151 s half crossing to 0.587 s, close to the 0.614 s model prediction.
interpretation.limitation: The filter window was chosen after the frozen raw outcome was observed. This is not an amended validation result and cannot close the PRESLHY E5.1 gate.
interpretation.future_protocol_action: If retained, pre-register an instrument-bandwidth-based pressure preprocessing rule before opening a new holdout and report raw and filtered endpoints separately.

claim_boundary: Diagnostic evidence about measurement noise only; it does not establish model accuracy, permit case exclusion, or support an IJHE validation claim.
